question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood disorder (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for cyclic neutropenia.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a follow-up evaluation of his cyclic neutropenia. He reports that his condition remains stable, characterized by recurring low neutrophil counts every few weeks. He has been adherent to his current management plan and reports no significant adverse effects from his medications. He notes that the periodic drops in his white blood cell count have been manageable with his current regimen.

Medication List
Granulocyte-colony stimulating factor (G-CSF) as needed.

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. Skin is warm and dry without rashes. Heart rate is 72 beats per minute, blood pressure is 130/82 mmHg, and oxygen saturation is 98% on room air.

Assessment
1. Cyclic neutropenia: The patient continues to experience periodic fluctuations in his neutrophil counts. His condition is currently stable on G-CSF.

Plan
1. Continue current G-CSF protocol for cyclic neutropenia.
2. Monitor peripheral blood counts and schedule follow-up labs in one month.
3. Return to clinic as needed or for scheduled review.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, PA-C
May 14, 2026
